limitations: Symbolic transitions and integrality certificates verify mathematical models bound to the actual content. REVIEWED separates author review of logic, domains and written explanations; it is not external peer review.
Short checks assess proof ingredients and exact algebra, not the validity of a submitted full proof. Written induction proofs retain manual DRAFT guidance.
Finite substitutions are additional diagnostics; general identities use a symbolic forward implication and a base case.
